newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain, France committed to join EMU launch - Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain, France committed to join EMU launch - Rato.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis and his Spanish counterpart Rodrigo Rato on Monday reaffirmed both nations' commitment to be part of European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) from its launch in 1999.
"We would like to highlight once again the willingness of both governments and both of our peoples that France and Spain will form part of EMU from January 1, 1999," Rato told a press conference.
Arthuis expressed confidence Spain intends to meet EMU convergence criteria.
"France is confident of the determination of the Spanish government to meet the convergence criteria in 1997 and to be in the group of nations launching EMU in 1999," he said.
"I am impressed by the efficiency of Minister Rato's (convergence) policy," he added.
Rato added there were signs of an economic pick-up in both France and Spain, as well in most European Union member nations, providing a strong backdrop for the convergence process.
